body.x: Bluemaestro(www.bluemaestro.com), a leading designer and developer of connected products and solutions from consumer devices to medicine adherence sensors, unveiled "Pacif-i" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas. Pacif-i records a baby’s temperature and passes it to a parent’s smartphone so that they can check and record the condition of the baby real time. It comes with a range of other useful features, such as the ability to find the pacifier with the smartphone as well as a proximity feature that alerts the smartphone if the location of the pacifier is out of range.
